title: Bangla Speech Corpora (acoustic-analysis, diphone, continuous-speech corpora)
why_promising: Primary supervised onsite Bangla read-speech recordings developed specifically for acoustic analysis, diphone synthesis, and intonation/unit-selection work. The authoritative repository explicitly states professional studio recording and manual segmentation, making the resource strongly compatible with the database's human-grounded production criteria. The release lineage points to a 4.4-GB public corpus hosted on SourceForge/Mendeley and to Alam et al. (2010).
open_question: HIGH review pending file-level enumeration of the SourceForge/Mendeley deposit, license verification, and confirmation of the exact segmentation/annotation formats and variables. Admit only original human productions and manual segmentation/labels; separate any synthesis-oriented derived assets if present. Preserve all acoustic-analysis and intonation annotations once file-level provenance is established.
